correctness.rationale: With a=h−1, g(C)=2a+k+1 and 2k transverse intersection points, the two curves have self-intersection −d with d=4a+2k. Since d−2k=4a>0, the intersection matrix Q is negative definite. Mayer–Vietoris gives H1 of the exceptional union free rank 4g+2k−1; Poincaré–Lefschetz duality and the pair exact sequence inject coker(Q) as torsion of H1(link). The Smith invariants of Q are 2gcd(2a,k) and 8a(a+k)/gcd(2a,k), and b=8a+6k+3 and T=16a(a+k) give u=(b−3)/2, discriminant u²−3T/4=(2a+3k)² and the unique smaller root a=(u−sqrt(...))/2. The c2 formula −2k−2k²/a is explicitly credited to Du; constructive a,k realize exactly all negative integers <=−3. Independent exact arithmetic checked 3,600 (a,k) parameter pairs and 498 consecutive negative integer targets, corroborating but not replacing the topology.
